title: NexusDev pipeline state
description: Shape of context/STATE.json, specified in MASTER_PLAN.md 3.4. This file is the single source of truth: scripts/validate_state.py interprets it rather than restating its rules, and refuses to run if it contains a keyword the validator does not implement. STATE.json itself is a rebuildable cache, so its absence is valid.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. A consumer that does not recognise the major version must refuse to act on the file.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last write.

updated_by.description: Which node performed the last write. Node names come from MASTER_PLAN.md 3.1.

lock.description: Advisory lock guarding task claims. MASTER_PLAN.md 9: a lock past its TTL may be broken, and breaking it is the router's decision, not a schema error.

held_by.description: Run identifier holding the lock, or null when free.

quota.description: Live availability of each backend, so the router can park work instead of burning retries.

resets_at.description: When an exhausted quota returns, or null when not known.

tasks.description: Per-task runtime state, keyed by the task id used in context/TODO.md.

status.description: Lifecycle position from MASTER_PLAN.md 4. Must agree with the block in context/TODO.md.

branch.description: Agent working branch, or null before a claim.

attempts.description: MASTER_PLAN.md 4: three attempts force the task to blocked, so a higher count means the cap was bypassed.

pr.description: Pull request number once one is open, else null.
